**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline.**

- **§ 9.4** grants us (Customer) a convenience termination right over the Agreement or any Order Form, with **§ 29.4** setting the notice period at **thirty days** — exactly the preferred standard.
- **No penalty or early-termination fee**: we owe only accrued Fees, and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, reinforced by **§ 10.2**.
- **No Vendor convenience right**: Vendor's termination rights are confined to uncured material breach (§ 9.1) and insolvency (§ 9.2); § 8.2 gives only us the non-renewal right, so Vendor cannot exit the three-year term (§ 8.1).
- **No hidden exit charges** in §§ 10–11; transition assistance is at our request at Order Form rates.

One adjacent note (not this rule, and not flagged here to avoid double-counting): § 7.7 imposes a 15%-of-annual-Fees-per-week "liquidated damages" charge for late payment. That is a payment-penalty issue rather than a termination fee, but it is aggressive and worth addressing under the fees/late-payment rule.
